hero_eyebrow: Professional Painters & Decorators — Bristol & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that lasts. Free estimates, no pressure. Call us today for a fresh look.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle residential and commercial projects with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep thoroughly, apply quality paints, and leave your rooms looking brand new. Perfect for a quick refresh or a complete room transformation.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paints that protect and enhance your home's kerb appeal. We work in all seasons and prepare surfaces properly for a finish that lasts years.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation for any room. We measure, cut, and hang with precision, ensuring pattern match and a flawless finish.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties redecorated to a high standard. We work around your schedule and minimise disruption to your business.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Interior and exterior doors, skirting boards, and frames painted with attention to detail. Smooth, hardwearing finishes that look sharp for years.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: We don't cut corners. Surface prep, crack filling, and minor repairs included in every job. A solid base ensures a perfect paint finish.

about_pullquote: We take pride in the detail. Every job's done right, first time.
about_para_1: M & R Decorating has been serving Bristol homes and businesses for over 15 years. What started as a small operation in Stoke Gifford has grown through word-of-mouth and repeat customers who trust us with their most visible spaces. We've completed over 800 interior and exterior projects across Bristol, and we still approach every one with the same care.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honest pricing, reliable timekeeping, and finishes that genuinely last. We don't use cheap materials or cut preparation short. Customers return to us because we listen, we show up on time, and we leave their homes looking better than promised.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job. Marcus came out, gave us a fair quote, and got started within the week. The whole house was freshened up in five days. He's tidy, professional, and left zero mess. Already recommended him to two neighbours.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen and living room done. They took time to prep the walls properly, and the paint finish is immaculate. Not the cheapest, but you get what you pay for. Won't use anyone else now.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on our exterior. No pressure, realistic timescale, fair price. Work was started on time and finished when they said it would. Looks fantastic. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert H.
